Wake up and look past the scripted illusion they are feeding you. The official line claims that the IOC’s landmark decision to ban transgender women and DSD athletes from the female category of events at the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics and future Games is about "fairness and safety." That is the exact inversion of reality. 

When Kirsty Coventry, president of the IOC, comes out and states that “It would not be fair for biological males to compete in the female category,” you are witnessing a carefully managed diversion orchestrated by the global elite. They are manufacturing these exact divisions to keep everyone distracted from the deeper, centralized control mechanisms that are secretly tightening around every single sports institution. The whole excuse about protection is nothing more than a smokescreen designed to hide the true coordination happening at the highest levels.
